newsitem.title: USA: CSCE coffee called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE coffee called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE coffee futures were called to open little changed Tuesday, although some traders expected prices to come in weaker in a correction following the market's recent strong showing.
"It's still a little overbought," one trader said. "A lot of people are long which makes me think the market's going to dip a bit."

Monday, New York arabica futures ended firmer but below session highs. July closed up 2.35 cents at 218.50 cents a lb after ranging from 224.50 and 214.50 cents. Spot May settled up 3.35 cents at 250.90, while the back months closed 3.00 firmer to 0.10 weaker.
Technically, traders pegged near-term support at Monday's low of 214.50 basis July, with the next level seen at 209.00. Resistance was put at 225.00, its lifeime high.
After Monday's close, CSCE reported certified coffee stocks fell by 1,250 bags, to 41,668 bags as of May 2. There here were 12,727 bags of coffee pending grading.
The London coffee futures were higher in quiet trading early Tuesday, bolstered by fund buying. LIFFE July was up $27 at the midday break, to $1,697, the day's high.
